protocol.known_total: MLP composition multiplied by label total; not blind absolute quantification
protocol.absolute_spectrum: ExtraTrees held-out normalized-ratio-group 5-fold prediction of log2 total from map-spectrum, signal and NNLS-amplitude summaries; multiplied by the same MLP composition
protocol.all_channel_errors: include the absent binary output channel
protocol.absolute_model_selection_note: ExtraTrees was the lowest all-condition component MAE among the previously tested total heads; selection is exploratory
